name: How should I prepare my kitchen before backsplash tile installation?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my kitchen before backsplash tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clear your kitchen counters completely of small appliances, cutting boards, and countertop decor. Make sure the sink area and nearby floor space are accessible so installers can set up a workspace and run power cords. If you plan to update under-cabinet lighting or swap out electrical outlet covers, have those fixtures or switch plates ready beforehand. If existing tile must be removed, plan for brief dust control measures, though professional installers lay drop cloths over countertops, ranges, and flooring to protect them.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all countertops completely, move items near the sink and stove, and make sure power outlets are accessible so the installation crew can work safely.
